live_bracketed_requires: Two distinct licensed market-data providers with documented internal benchmark storage/use permission and distinct independence groups.
For each comparison, provider quote timestamps, evaluator captured_at, market session, timezone, currency, and unit.
A pre-bound staleness limit, cross-source skew limit, and tick tolerance; none may be inferred after capture.
A declared before/after or dual-reference capture method, preserved in evidence receipts and independently reviewed.
admission_rule.replay_fixture_rule: A replay fixture may support deterministic regression only. It must use snapshot_mode=replay_fixture and evaluation_use=non_formal_replay_only; it never contributes to formal data_accuracy or rankings.
admission_rule.hard_scoring_exclusion: Candidate provider tool parameters are not a hard-scoring target.

conclusion: No authorized dual-provider realtime reference source or pre-bound capture policy is present in this package. No case is admitted for formal realtime value-oracle freezing.
